company.name: Printify
company.shortDescription: Printify is a platform that connects e-commerce merchants, marketplaces and print on demand dropshipping producers.
company.description:
Printify is the world's most famous print-on-demand platform designed to help anyone with an internet connection unlock the freedom that comes with opening your own online business. And because it’s completely risk free, more than 10 million people have signed up to open their stores! 
We created Printify so that anyone can create great products, drive sales, and unlock their freedom. Printify has been on a steep growth curve since 2015, and now with more than 700 employees, three offices, and an amazing diverse team spread around Europe, we’re continuing to go from strength to strength. The Financial Times has ranked us as a Best Startup Employer for the last 4 years in a row, and we’re headquartered in Riga with  investment backing from Richard Branson, Index Ventures, and some of the best angel investors from Silicon Valley and beyond.

aiResearchSummary.text: Printify is researching methods and systems for analyzing the quality of a design printed on a substrate, such as a garment, as described in Automated garment print quality control for garment tracking, processing. These developments focus on evaluating both the properties of the garment and the quality of the printed design, supporting enhanced quality control in print on demand dropshipping. The research addresses automated quality assessment and garment tracking within the print-on-demand workflow.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $45,000,000, or 91.74% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,015,834 to $300,000,000, a 295.32x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 77 (-4 over 90 days) and market heat at 54 (-38).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Snappy, Gelato, ShineOn.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
